name: Cross Expand
description: A plus/cross shape with corner squares that expand outward, rotate 90 degrees, then contract back

variations.name: default
variations.description: Static center cross with four corner squares that expand outward, rotate 90°, then retract in a pulsing geometric pattern

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the cross and corner squares

props.name: crossThickness
props.description: Thickness of the center cross bars in pixels

props.name: cornerSize
props.description: Width and height of each corner square in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
